services.name: Skin fade
services.title: Skin fade haircut in Bradford | Demo Fade Co. (fictional)
services.meta_description: Skin fade haircuts in Bradford at Demo Fade Co. (fictional): sides and back taken down to the skin and blended into the length on top.
body: A skin fade takes the sides and back down to bare skin at the bottom and blends gradually into longer hair on top. The height of the fade, low, mid or high, changes the whole look, so tell your barber where you want the blend to start.
Bring a photo if you have a style in mind. A fade grows out over a few weeks; many people come back regularly to keep the line sharp.
Skin fades are one of the two services we offer at our Bradford shop, along with beard trims.

services.name: Beard trim
services.title: Beard trim in Bradford | Demo Fade Co. (fictional)
services.meta_description: Beard trims in Bradford at Demo Fade Co. (fictional): length taken down evenly, neckline and cheek lines cleaned up, shape kept natural.
body: A beard trim brings the length down evenly, tidies the neckline under the jaw and cleans up the cheek line so the shape looks deliberate rather than overgrown.
Say whether you are keeping length or going shorter, and whether you want a sharp or soft cheek line. A trim pairs well with a haircut so the sideburns blend into the beard.
